'''Benjamin Bederson''' (November 15, 1921 – January 6, 2023) was an American physicist. He worked on the [[Manhattan Project]].<ref>{{Cite web|title=Benjamin Bederson|url=https://www.atomicheritage.org/profile/benjamin-bederson|access-date=2021-06-08|website=Atomic Heritage Foundation|language=en}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|title=From Army Private to Atomic Physicist: Benjamin Bederson Got the Chance of a Lifetime|url=https://www.bnl.gov/newsroom/news.php?a=26221|access-date=2021-06-08|website=Brookhaven National Laboratory|language=en}}</ref><ref>{{Cite news|last=Barron|first=James|date=2015-07-26|title=A Manhattan Project Veteran Had a Unique View of Atomic Bomb Work|language=en-US|work=The New York Times|url=https://www.nytimes.com/2015/07/27/nyregion/a-manhattan-project-veteran-reflects-on-his-atomic-bomb-work.html|access-date=2021-06-08|issn=0362-4331}}</ref>

==Background==
Bederson graduated from [[City College of New York]], [[Columbia University]], and [[New York University]].<ref>{{Cite web|title=Bederson, Benjamin|url=https://history.aip.org/phn/11410017.html|access-date=2021-06-08|website=history.aip.org}}</ref> He worked at [[Massachusetts Institute of Technology]] and was a [[Dean (education)#United States|dean]] at New York University.<ref>{{Cite web|title=Seven Decades Ago, A New, Enormous Kind Of Explosion|url=https://www.npr.org/2015/07/17/423740547/seven-decades-ago-a-new-enormous-kind-of-explosion|access-date=2021-06-08|website=NPR.org|language=en}}</ref> From 1992 to 1996, he was an Editor-in-Chief of ''[[Physical Review]].''<ref>{{Cite journal|title=Bederson Succeeds Lazarus as APS Editor in Chief|url=http://physicstoday.scitation.org/doi/10.1063/1.2809490|journal=Physics Today|year=1992 |language=en|volume=45|issue=1|pages=61–62|doi=10.1063/1.2809490|bibcode=1992PhT....45a..61. |issn=0031-9228|url-access=subscription}}</ref> 

In 1959, Bederson was elected a Fellow of the [[American Physical Society]].<ref>{{cite web|title=APS Fellow Archive|url=https://www.aps.org/programs/honors/fellowships/archive-all.cfm?initial=&year=1959&unit_id=APS&institution=|website=www.aps.org|publisher=[[American Physical Society]]|language=en|access-date=November 7, 2022}}</ref>

Bederson died on January 6, 2023, at the age of 101.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Dr. Benjamin Bederson Obituary: November 15, 1921 — January 6, 2023 |url=http://www.bederson.org/benjamin-bederson-obituary.html |access-date=2023-02-03 |website=www.bederson.org}}</ref>
